## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior, failure cases, or invariants as applicable.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] Source lineage and third-party notices are updated where needed.
